name: logicprobe
description: Design document & plan claim verification — logic primitives + adversarial probing for behavioral claims. State machines, data models, protocol logic, and refactoring plans get executable-model verification (state machine S1-S8/A1-A11, data model DS/DA/DD) with before/after regression detection.

interface.shortDescription: Claim verification for design docs & plans — logic primitives + adversarial probing
interface.longDescription: Documents are not truth — code is. Verifies every verifiable claim in design documents, architecture specs, and refactoring plans against the actual codebase, then escalates to executable-model verification for behavioral claims: 8 structural checks and 11 adversarial probes. Data-model verification adds DS/DA/DD checks for schemas, migrations, copy consistency, and data invariants. Before/after model comparison catches regressions. Python harnesses included, with manual fallback for air-gapped machines.
